overview.Name: Cushman & Wakefield Limited
overview.Description: Cushman & Wakefield Limited is a leading global commercial real estate services firm for property owners and occupiers with approximately 52,000 employees in nearly 400 offices and 60 countries. In 2024, the firm reported revenue of 9.4 billion dollars across its core service lines of Services, Leasing, Capital markets, and Valuation and others. The company was founded in 1784 and is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.
